# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 22 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 22:1 — on the knees of Jacob — idiom

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "his sons were on the knees of Jacob" | Literal epi tōn gonaton Iakōb |
| LOGOS | "his sons were placed on Jacob's knees" | Adds 'placed' for clarity — adoption gesture |
| PNEUMA | "whose children Jacob held on his knees" | Paraphrase conveying the adoption custom |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS adds 'placed' which clarifies the adoption-ceremony gesture (cf. Gen 50:23). EMET is literal but potentially unclear. PNEUMA's 'held' paraphrases the posture accurately. Adopted LOGOS for clarity.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 22:4 — one hundred and forty-seven years — matches Genesis

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "one hundred and forty-seven years" | Matches Gen 47:28 |
| LOGOS | "a hundred and forty-seven years" | Natural English |
| PNEUMA | "one hundred and forty-seven years old" | Adds 'old' |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS is most natural. 'A hundred and forty-seven years' is standard English. PNEUMA's 'old' is implied. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
